# Game Idea: Orbit Escape

**Concept**: Pilot a small spacecraft around a rotating planet on an HTML canvas. Collect fuel cells while dodging space debris and resisting the planet’s gravity.

**Controls**: Arrow keys – rotate ship and thrust forward.

**Lose Condition**: The game ends when the ship runs out of fuel **or** collides with debris.

**Goal**: Survive as long as possible and achieve the highest score by gathering fuel cells.

1: // Orbit Escape – concise canvas game
2: // Canvas element assumed: <canvas id="game"></canvas>
3: (() => {
4:   // Audio setup using Web Audio API
5:   const AudioContext = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
6:   const audioCtx = new AudioContext();
7:   // Helper to play a beep at given frequency and duration
8:   function beep(freq, duration) {
9:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
10:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
11:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
12:     osc.type = 'square';
13:     osc.connect(gain);
14:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
17:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
18:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration / 1000);
20:   }
21:   function playThrust() { beep(440, 50); }
22:   function playCollision() { beep(100, 300); }
23:   function playCollect() { beep(660, 100); }
24:   function playGameOver() { beep(200, 500); }
25:   // Ensure audio context resumes on first user interaction
26:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
27:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
28:   }, { once: true });
29:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
30:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
31:   const WIDTH = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
32:   const HEIGHT = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
33:   const CENTER = { x: WIDTH / 2, y: HEIGHT / 2 };
34: 
35:   // Ship state
36:   const ship = {
37:     x: CENTER.x,
38:     y: CENTER.y - 50,
39:     r: 10,
40:     angle: 0,
41:     vx: 0,
42:     vy: 0,
43:     thrust: 0.1,
44:     rotSpeed: 0.07,
45:     fuel: 100,
46:   };
47: 
48:   // Game objects
49:   const debris = [];
50:   const fuelCells = [];
51:   let score = 0;
52:   let gameOver = false;
53: const stars = [];
54: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
55:   stars.push({ x: Math.random() * WIDTH, y: Math.random() * HEIGHT, r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
56: }
57: const particles = [];
58: 
59:   // Utility helpers
60:   const dist = (a, b) => Math.hypot(a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y);
61:   const rand = (min, max) => Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
62: 
63:   // Populate obstacles and fuel
64:   for (let i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
65:     debris.push({ x: rand(0, WIDTH), y: rand(0, HEIGHT), r: rand(8, 15) });
66:   }
67:   for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
68:     fuelCells.push({ x: rand(0, WIDTH), y: rand(0, HEIGHT), r: 6, collected: false });
69:   }
70: 
71:   // Input handling
72:   const keys = {};
73:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.key] = true));
74:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.key] = false));
75: 
76:   function update() {
77:   // Update particles
78:   for (let i = particles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
79:     const p = particles[i];
80:     p.x += p.vx;
81:     p.y += p.vy;
82:     p.life--;
83:     if (p.life <= 0) particles.splice(i, 1);
84:   }
85:     if (gameOver) return;
86:     // Rotation
87:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.angle -= ship.rotSpeed;
88:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
89:     // Thrust
90:     if (keys.ArrowUp && ship.fuel > 0) {
91:       playThrust();
92:       // Generate thrust particles
93:       const angle = ship.angle + Math.PI; // opposite direction
94:       const px = ship.x + Math.cos(angle) * ship.r;
95:       const py = ship.y + Math.sin(angle) * ship.r;
96:       particles.push({
97:         x: px,
98:         y: py,
99:         vx: Math.cos(angle) * (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5),
100:         vy: Math.sin(angle) * (Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5),
101:         life: 20,
102:         size: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
103:         color: 'rgba(255,165,0,0.8)'
104:       });
105:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
106:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
107:       ship.fuel -= 0.2;
108:     }
109:       ship.vx += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
110:       ship.vy += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.thrust;
111:       ship.fuel -= 0.2;
112:     }
113:     // Gravity toward center
114:     const dx = CENTER.x - ship.x;
115:     const dy = CENTER.y - ship.y;
116:     const distToCenter = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
117:     const gravity = 0.02 * (distToCenter / Math.max(WIDTH, HEIGHT));
118:     ship.vx += (dx / distToCenter) * gravity;
119:     ship.vy += (dy / distToCenter) * gravity;
120:     // Move ship
121:     ship.x += ship.vx;
122:     ship.y += ship.vy;
123:     // Wrap around edges
124:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x += WIDTH;
125:     if (ship.x > WIDTH) ship.x -= WIDTH;
126:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y += HEIGHT;
127:     if (ship.y > HEIGHT) ship.y -= HEIGHT;
128:     // Collision with debris
129:     for (const d of debris) {
130: if (dist(ship, d) < ship.r + d.r) {
131:           playCollision();
132:           gameOver = true;
133:           break;
134:         }
135:     }
136:     // Collect fuel cells
137:     for (const f of fuelCells) {
138: if (!f.collected && dist(ship, f) < ship.r + f.r) {
139:           f.collected = true;
140:           ship.fuel = Math.min(ship.fuel + 30, 100);
141:           score += 10;
142:           playCollect();
143:         }
144:     }
145:     // Lose if out of fuel
146:     if (ship.fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
147:   }
148: 
149:   function draw() {
150:     // Clear background
151:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
152:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
153:     // Draw stars
154:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
155:     for (const s of stars) {
156:       ctx.beginPath();
157:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
158:       ctx.fill();
159:     }
160:     // Draw particles (thrust)
161:     for (const p of particles) {
162:       ctx.fillStyle = p.color;
163:       ctx.beginPath();
164:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
165:       ctx.fill();
166:     }
167: // Planet (center) with gradient aura and glow
168:   ctx.save();
169:   ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
170:   ctx.shadowColor = '#4ca1af';
171:   const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(CENTER.x, CENTER.y, 10, CENTER.x, CENTER.y, 30);
172:   planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4ca1af');
173:   planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2c3e50');
174:   ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
175:   ctx.beginPath();
176:   ctx.arc(CENTER.x, CENTER.y, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
177:   ctx.fill();
178:   ctx.restore();
179:     // Ship
180:     ctx.save();
181:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
182:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
183:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ecf0f1';
184:     ctx.beginPath();
185:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
186:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
187:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
188:     ctx.closePath();
189:     ctx.fill();
190:     ctx.restore();
191:     // Debris
192:     ctx.fillStyle = '#c0392b';
193:     for (const d of debris) {
194:       ctx.beginPath();
195:       ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
196:       ctx.fill();
197:     }
198:     // Fuel cells
199:     ctx.fillStyle = '#27ae60';
200:     for (const f of fuelCells) {
201:       if (f.collected) continue;
202:       ctx.beginPath();
203:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
204:       ctx.fill();
205:     }
206:     // HUD
207:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
208:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
209:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(ship.fuel)}`, 10, 20);
210:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 40);
211:     if (gameOver) {
212:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
213:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WIDTH, HEIGHT);
214:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
215:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
216:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
217:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 - 10);
218:       ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
219:       ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, WIDTH / 2, HEIGHT / 2 + 20);
220:     }
221:   }
222: 
223:   function loop() {
224:     update();
225:     draw();
226:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
227:   }
228: 
229:   // Start the game
230:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
231: })();

(End of file - total 231 lines)
</content>
